fixEditorReactivity.title: Fix Editor Reactivity Workflow
fixEditorReactivity.objective: Fix the issue where switching between notes in the sidebar doesn't update the editor content until the page is refreshed.
fixEditorReactivity.rootCauseDescription: The `NoteEditor` component uses `useCreateBlockNote` hook which creates the editor instance with `initialContent`. However:
fixEditorReactivity.cause2: When `noteId` changes, React re-renders the component
fixEditorReactivity.cause3: BUT `useCreateBlockNote` does NOT reinitialize the editor - it's a custom hook that creates the instance once
fixEditorReactivity.cause4: Result: Old content remains until page refresh

optionA.title: Option A: Force Remount with Key (Recommended)
optionA.description: Add a `key` prop to the wrapper div to force React to remount the entire component when `noteId` changes.
optionA.pros: Simple, guaranteed to work, clean slate for each note
optionA.cons: Loses editor state (cursor position, undo history) - acceptable for notes

optionB.title: Option B: Use replaceBlocks
optionB.description: Call `editor.replaceBlocks()` in a useEffect when noteId changes.
optionB.cons: More complex, may have edge cases with BlockNote's internal state

fixEditorReactivity.ifOptionAFails: If Option A causes issues, use this instead:
fixEditorReactivity.emptyNote: Empty note: Switching to a note with no content should show empty editor
fixEditorReactivity.noteWithImages: Note with images/embeds: Complex content should load correctly
fixEditorReactivity.rapidSwitching: Rapid switching: Click multiple notes quickly - should show final note's content
fixEditorReactivity.unsavedChanges: Unsaved changes: If debounce is pending, should still save before switching
